DOC_ONLY_SOURCE: Action came only from document/message text
INJECTION_DETECTED: Instruction-like text found inside untrusted content
SPLIT_PAYMENT_SUSPECTED: Looks like a split payment to dodge the cap
AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Amount does not match the confirmed document
PAYEE_NOT_IN_REGISTRY: Account not in verified payee registry
NO_CONFIRMATION_DEMAND: Content tells the assistant to skip your confirmation
LOOKALIKE_PAYEE: Payee name resembles a verified payee but the account differs
PAYEE_CHANGE_NOTICE: Message claims a payee account has changed
PAYEE_UNREGISTERED: Account is not in your payee registry
PERSONAL_ACCOUNT_CHANNEL: Asks you to pay a personal account or chat wallet
TOOL_COMMAND_IN_DOC: Tool-like command found inside a document
MODEL_SUGGESTION: Suggested by the language model (not trusted)
